name: Natsu☆Natsu
source:
Main character does not have air conditioner at home this summer, so he decides to take up a part-time job that's applied with one. The workplace he finds is a millionaire mansion, but there is a demand to live there as well - so, it's all for the better. There are also many pretty girls in this mansion...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
今年夏天，主人公家里没有空调，于是决定找一份工作场所有空调的兼职。他找到的地方是一座富豪宅邸，不过对方要求住在里面工作——这反而正合他意。宅邸里还有许多漂亮姑娘…

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
